slide1.title: Connecting Africa to the World Through Reliable Logistics
slide1.description: Parrot Cargo & Logistics delivers fast, secure, and professional freight forwarding solutions across Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and global markets through air freight, sea freight, customs clearance, and project cargo services.
slide1.cardText: Fast global cargo movement through trusted airline logistics networks.

slide2.title: Reliable Sea Freight for Global Trade Routes
slide2.description: Move containers, commercial cargo, and business shipments through dependable ocean freight solutions designed for international trade and regional distribution.
slide2.cardText: Efficient sea freight services for businesses shipping across global markets.

slide3.title: Secure Cargo Handling from Pickup to Delivery
slide3.description: From cargo collection and warehousing to customs coordination and final delivery, Parrot Cargo keeps every shipment organized, visible, and protected.
slide3.cardText: Professional cargo handling, storage, and delivery support for every shipment.
